title: "Organizing Team"

Our organizing team is made up of people from ESA, Openscapes, Lampata, and Telespazio, we all share in the various [roles](roles.qmd) it takes to organize a successful hackathon. We are committed to making this hackathon a welcoming and inclusive event for all participants, and we are excited to work with you to make this hackathon a success!

**Krasen Samardzhiev** (Lampata): Lead developer and teacher\
**Julie Lowndes** (Openscapes): Co-lead designer and co-facilitator\
